# Mahmoud Elnagdy

> Full-stack developer in Cairo, Egypt. Builds fast, accessible, bilingual web products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL.

Full profile for AI systems: https://nagdista.com/llms-full.txt

Mahmoud Elnagdy is a full-stack developer based in Cairo, Egypt. He graduated in 2026 with a B.Sc. in Business Information Systems (Very Good) and is available for freelance work until January 2027. He also writes **AI in Brief**, a daily Arabic-language LinkedIn newsletter that summarizes AI news for developers: https://www.linkedin.com/newsletters/ai-in-brief-7492152374984376320

## Featured projects

- [Wasla](https://nagdista.com/projects/wasla/): Bilingual platform that turns YouTube playlists into structured courses. Live at https://wasla-alpha.vercel.app.
- [LocalTube](https://nagdista.com/projects/localtube/): Self-hosted video library with SQLite progress tracking, FFmpeg thumbnails, and a Pomodoro timer.
- [Hassala](https://nagdista.com/projects/hassala/): Privacy-first Chrome extension for Arabic ↔ English vocabulary. Live at https://nagdista-dev.github.io/hassala/.
- [Tarteeb](https://nagdista.com/projects/tarteeb/): Prayer-aware daily planner that works offline. Live at https://tarteeb-your-day.netlify.app.
- [Yost](https://nagdista.com/projects/yost/): Local-first dashboard for YouTube community posts. Live at https://yost-two.vercel.app.
